evidenceIntakeCandidates.excerpt: The current video model is Ray3.2
If your character or product keeps subtly changing

planRequirement.en: For the Luma Agents API, confirm account access and pay-per-generation cost before use. Verify App plan access, credits, and commercial terms separately.
planRequirement.cn: 使用 Luma Agents API 前确认账号权限与按次生成费用；App 套餐权限、credits 和商用条款须单独核实。

limitations: EN: An input image can guide generation but exact packaging, marks, and text need human frame review. CN: 输入图可引导生成，但包装、标识和文字仍须人工逐帧核验。
EN: The Agents API model page lists 5s and 10s for video. Do not promise a single 20s image-to-video output. CN: Agents API 模型页列视频 5/10 秒；不得承诺单次 20 秒图片转视频。
EN: API video edits and reframing do not establish a full timeline editor or the same App controls. CN: API 局部改片和改比例不证明完整时间线编辑器或 App 具有相同控制项。

rationale.en: Ray3.2 on the Agents API accepts image anchors for short video generation. Luma is a conditional fit when a person can verify the product's visual identity and the selected App or API workflow is confirmed separately.
rationale.cn: Agents API 的 Ray3.2 可用图片锚生成短视频；只有可人工核验产品外观，并单独确认所选 App 或 API 工作流时，Luma 才是有条件适配。

requiredConditions.en: The user has rights to the source image and any marks or people shown.
requiredConditions.cn: 用户有权使用源图片及其中的标识或人物。

requiredConditions.en: A reviewer can check product identity, text, color, and shape in the resulting frames.
requiredConditions.cn: 审核者可核查生成画面中的产品身份、文字、颜色和形状。

requiredConditions.en: The selected App or API account has confirmed access, budget, duration, output, and commercial terms.
requiredConditions.cn: 所选 App 或 API 账号的权限、预算、时长、输出和商用条款均已确认。

disqualifiers.en: The deliverable requires guaranteed frame-perfect packaging, marks, or text without review.
disqualifiers.cn: 交付要求未经人工核验也保证每帧包装、标识或文字完全一致。

disqualifiers.en: The work requires a full timeline editor, captions, music mixing, or multi-shot assembly inside Luma.
disqualifiers.cn: 工作要求在 Luma 内完成完整时间线剪辑、字幕、配乐混音或多镜头装配。

disqualifiers.en: Required App or API access, duration, output, or commercial terms cannot be confirmed.
disqualifiers.cn: 所需 App 或 API 权限、时长、输出或商用条款无法确认。

holdReasons: No direct Ray3.2 App-plan entitlement and no justified non-unknown availability enum for the existing broad Luma Tool Capability.
Official API 5s/10s generation parameters and separate 20s video-to-video wording cannot be merged into one image-to-video limit.
App export and commercial terms must not be inferred from Agents API behavior or legacy API FAQ.
Independent source excerpt, DOM/table context, reviewer, expiry, and current-production preflight are still required.

proposedOldEvidenceDisposition.unlink: Both old links to the old homepage claim, after checking the exact link set has not changed.
proposedOldEvidenceDisposition.claim: Keep both old claims and all four old sources for audit. Mark the old verified claim superseded or invalidated only after independent review; leave the rejected claim unchanged. Never restore the old homepage claim as current evidence.

operatorGuards: No production writes from this artifact; no publish manifest while availability evidence is missing.
Before any later write, re-read the exact IDs, status, reviewer, updated_at, claim IDs, link set, source counts, and profile owner/domain; abort on any mismatch.
Require an identified auth.users reviewer, fresh official excerpts, direct value support, review_due_at within 90 days, and domain under lumalabs.ai before calling decision_official_evidence_intake.
Keep Tool Capability and Fit reviewed during independent QA; require Tool purposes support/availability/plan/limitation and Fit purposes fit/limitation before decision_cluster_transition preflight.
Do not run SQL or transition a Task, Capability, Tool Capability, or Fit from this candidate without a separately approved QA result.
rollbackPlan: If a later guarded transaction fails, roll it back and verify the old IDs, statuses, and link counts are unchanged.
If a later publication commits and QA fails, use the CL-01 exact-manifest withdrawal to move the cluster to stale, then read back every affected relation and link.
Do not resurrect the old homepage claim or delete claim/source audit history; prepare a new reviewed candidate from a fresh baseline.
